category.recordmc.title: RecordMC
config.comment.fps: Target recording frame rate (FPS). 60 is recommended.
recordmc.config.comment.fps: Target recording frame rate (FPS). 60 is recommended.
config.comment.crf: H.264 quality factor (0-51). Lower values mean higher quality and larger file size (recommended: 18-23).
recordmc.config.comment.crf: H.264 quality factor (0-51). Lower values mean higher quality and larger file size (recommended: 18-23).
config.comment.preset: FFmpeg encoding preset. Click to cycle through options (ultrafast is recommended for minimal impact on gameplay).
recordmc.config.comment.preset: FFmpeg encoding preset. Click to cycle through options (ultrafast is recommended for minimal impact on gameplay).
config.comment.recordaudio: Whether to record internal Minecraft game audio (sound effects, music, ambient).
recordmc.config.comment.record_audio: Whether to record internal Minecraft game audio (sound effects, music, ambient).
config.comment.showindicator: Whether to show the red REC dot and elapsed time in the top-right corner during recording.
recordmc.config.comment.show_indicator: Whether to show the red REC dot and elapsed time in the top-right corner during recording.
config.comment.copytoclipboard: Automatically copies the finished video file to clipboard upon recording completion (allows instant Ctrl+V pasting).
recordmc.config.comment.copy_to_clipboar: Automatically copies the finished video file to clipboard upon recording completion (allows instant Ctrl+V pasting).
config.comment.customffmpegpath: Path to the FFmpeg executable. Leave empty for auto-detection. Supports absolute paths (e.g. /usr/bin/ffmpeg, C:\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe), relative paths (e.g. ./ffmpeg), or system command names (ffmpeg).
recordmc.config.comment.custom_ffmpeg_pa: Path to the FFmpeg executable. Leave empty for auto-detection. Supports absolute paths (e.g. /usr/bin/ffmpeg, C:\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe), relative paths (e.g. ./ffmpeg), or system command names (ffmpeg).
recordmc.config.status.not_detected: Not detected (Please check PATH or installation)
config.comment.customvideodir: Destination folder for recordings. Leave empty to use ./video in the game directory. Supports absolute paths (e.g. /home/user/Videos, D:\Videos) or paths relative to the game directory (e.g. video, recordings).
recordmc.config.comment.custom_video_dir: Destination folder for recordings. Leave empty to use ./video in the game directory. Supports absolute paths (e.g. /home/user/Videos, D:\Videos) or paths relative to the game directory (e.g. video, recordings).
config.comment.opengui: Hotkey to open the RecordMC configuration menu (Default: H + R).
recordmc.config.comment.open_gui: Hotkey to open the RecordMC configuration menu (Default: H + R).
config.comment.togglerecording: Hotkey to start/stop video recording (Default: F9).
recordmc.config.comment.toggle_recording: Hotkey to start/stop video recording (Default: F9).
recordmc.message.error_ffmpeg_not_found: §c[RecordMC] FFmpeg was not found. Please install FFmpeg or set custom path in config.
config.comment.videoformat: Format/container of the output video file. Click to cycle between mp4, mov, mkv, and webm (Default: mp4).
recordmc.config.comment.video_format: Format/container of the output video file. Click to cycle between mp4, mov, mkv, and webm (Default: mp4).
